recordDecisions.title: Lenses make many points: pure point spectrum disproves Simon’s L² conjecture
recordDecisions.boundedClaim: For every d>=2 and0<=sigma<1/3, the authors construct a smooth bounded nonnegative potential V with arbitrarily small ||V||_infinity+integral |x|^(1−d+sigma)|V|², for which −Delta+V has only pure point spectrum on(0,infinity). This contradicts Simon’s stated weighted-L² absolutely-continuous-spectrum conjecture.
recordDecisions.aiContribution: Becker and Yang describe developing the initial construction with ChatGPT, which supplied the point-spectrum parameter adjustment, spectral averaging and extension from a bounded interval to the full positive spectrum; humans rewrote and checked the argument.
recordDecisions.furtherChecking: Independently check the lens and higher-dimensional construction, weighted norm, spectral averaging and the exact positive-energy meaning. Human responsibility and rewriting are not independent end-to-end proof verification. No downloaded proof artifact was executed. Retain provisional=1, low strict confidence, taxonomy unreviewed and no strict Superhuman override.
recordDecisions.comparator: Reported full disproof of the exact multidimensional Simon2000 Problem8, with directly attributed material AI construction and proof steps.
recordDecisions.dateBasis: Dated arXiv v1 submission history; later formalization is not another first-public paper.

recordDecisions.title: The Critical 2D KPZ Process
recordDecisions.boundedClaim: The paper constructs a non-Gaussian distribution-valued critical2D KPZ process as the unique limit in law of centered log partition functions of critical two-dimensional Gaussian directed polymers, and as a measurable renormalized Cole–Hopf function of the Critical2D Stochastic Heat Flow. It reports log-log covariance blow-up and small-scale Gaussian fluctuations. This is not universality for every microscopic KPZ model.
recordDecisions.aiContribution: The eleven authors disclose extensive ChatGPT5.5/5.6/6 contributions to tightness, convergence to a unique limit and non-Gaussianity, within human-supplied strategies and a decade-long research programme; AppendixC also records failed AI approaches and subsequent corrections.
recordDecisions.furtherChecking: Audit tightness, centering, uniqueness of the limiting law, SHF measurability and non-Gaussianity, including the failed intermediate strategies described in AppendixC. Do not extend Gaussian-polymer hypotheses to an unrestricted universality theorem. No downloaded proof artifact was executed. Retain provisional=1, low strict confidence, taxonomy unreviewed and no strict Superhuman override.
recordDecisions.comparator: A reported first construction at the long-standing critical2D KPZ frontier; medium confidence concerns precise historical target and scope, not a demand for independent proof checking.
recordDecisions.dateBasis: Dated arXiv v1 submission history; later formalization is not another first-public paper.

recordDecisions.title: Generalized Boyd constructions of small-Mahler-measure polynomials
recordDecisions.boundedClaim: The paper gives a five-parameter Generalized Boyd construction with a cyclotomic-free choice for every even degree d>=12 and reports exactly verified irreducible polynomials with Mahler measure below alpha1≈1.255434 for every even d in[12,2000]. The search improves six published values and attains99.6% of the reported records in that finite range. It does not resolve Lehmer’s problem.
recordDecisions.aiContribution: Chervonyi, Gukov and Luong describe a human–AI discovery loop using internal Gemini models including Gemini4Argon in Google Antigravity, which built numerical/symbolic search infrastructure, distributed searches and analytical conjecture extraction.
recordDecisions.furtherChecking: Separate the general cyclotomic-free degree construction from the finite verified measure sweep. Independently check irreducibility certificates, degree conventions, parameter bounds, alpha1 comparison and baseline-record ownership. Do not infer a universal Mahler gap or a disproof of Lehmer. No downloaded proof artifact was executed. Retain provisional=1, low strict confidence, taxonomy unreviewed and no strict Superhuman override.
